name: GOV extended: OwnershipHandoverRequested (Solady Ownable)
description: Solady Ownable: OwnershipHandoverRequested(address) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity info. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
